title: Hermite functions are square integrable
statement: For every natural number $n$ and multi-index $\alpha:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbb N$, the Hermite function indexed by $\alpha$ belongs to $L^2$ for the product of $n$ standard Gaussian measures.
